description: Nuclear facilities and uranium mines and mills is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission | Commission canadienne de sûreté nucléaire. Nuclear licensees operate across Canada. This includes uranium mines and mills, uranium processing facilities, nuclear power plants, research reactors, particle accelerators, and nuclear substances processing facilities. All of these facilities are licensed by the CNSC and are subject to strict regulatory oversight to ensure the safety of the public and the environment. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission | Commission canadienne de sûreté nucléaire. Its tags are Installations nucléaires, Environnement, Centrale nucléaire, Déchets radioactifs, Industrie minière. It offers 6 resource(s) in ESRI REST, FGDB/GDB, WMS. The portal shows 2022-08-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
